notes.title: Summer Sale 2023
notes.notes:
Summer has arrived, bringing with it the warmth of sunshine and the excitement of this sizzling Summer Sale! As the days get longer and the temperature rises, there's no better time to dive into some thrilling gaming adventures and enjoy fantastic deals. 

Embrace the spirit of the season with our incredible discounts on all titles in our vast catalog. We have something for everyone, whether you're craving action, adventure, or strategy. Enjoy captivating and exciting games like Human Fall Flat, The Ascent, Blooming Business: Casino, From Space, and the adventurous Patch Quest.  

So, grab your sunglasses, controller, mouse & keyboard, and get ready for a very hot gaming summer! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/curvesummer][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/854f506495036857d1dff23e769c6769033079d9.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Badlands Crew  
[/h1]
Join the crew and become a protector of The Citadel!  

Customize your battle wagon with a wide range of components and weapons, transforming it into a formidable force. Manage your crew's actions individually in combat, from manning guns to repairing vehicle components. Navigate hazardous environments and face off against savage militia groups led by crazed Warlords. Make strategic decisions that shape the campaign map and influence faction control.  

Your choices and skills will determine your success, plan wisely and fight fiercely! Wishlist and start your adventure into the lawless Badlands!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078230/

[h1]Dungeons of Hinterberg  
[/h1]
Grab your sword and prepare for an unforgettable adventure in the enchanting alpine village of Hinterberg!  

Join Luisa to conquer the mysterious Dungeons of Hinterberg. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this idyllic Austrian Alps destination as you navigate the charming village and uncover the hidden magic within its dungeons. Prepare yourself for a vacation like no other, where adventure and magic intertwine in the alpine paradise.  

Wishlist and join Luisa on the path to becoming a Master Slayer! Welcome to Hinterberg, where the magic of the dungeons awaits your arrival! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983260/

[h1]Kitbash Model Club 
[/h1]
Welcome to the sun-kissed paradise of Wirraway Island! 

Prepare for an exhilarating adventure where innovation meets limitless possibilities. Here, you have the power to transform your most daring RC model construction dreams into tangible reality. Unleash your creativity and push the boundaries of performance.  

Wish list now and embark on this extraordinary journey today and watch as your imagination takes flight! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107090/Kitbash_Model_Club/

[h1]Goblin Stone 
[/h1]
Attention, Gobbos! 

A new Dev Blog is out; check all the recent news about Goblin Stone and get ready to fight back! Goblins, orcs, and other monster folk rise against extinction. Wishlist now and join the Goblins in their fight for survival in this roguelike-turned-based RPG. Together, we will triumph! 

Onward, brave souls! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521970/Goblin_Stone/

[h1]For The King II  
[/h1]
Inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Prepare to confront Fahrul's once beloved Queen turned tyrant and her army of fearsome Queensguard in the highly anticipated sequel to For The King.  

Whether alone or with a party of four, unravel dark secrets, battle, loot and experience the thrill of this turn-based roguelike RPG.  Discover a host of fresh features, fearsome enemies and devilish dungeons across brand new epic campaigns.  Wishlist the game now and embark on a quest like no other. The Resistance is rising, join us Adventurers! 

Don’t miss the Curve bundles selection. Take advantage of this Sale, save money, and enjoy the spring season by adding some terrific games to your collection!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676840/For_The_King_II/

notes.title: Just Die Already 1.3.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The following summary covers the key areas we have addressed in this new Patch update for Just Die Already. This update is now available on all platforms.

[list]
    [*]Too much gore for you? You can now turn on and off the “Censored Gore” option in-game and enjoy a world of sunshine and rainbows. 
    [*]PC keys are now rebindable.
    [*]A “Return to Retirement Home” option has been added.
    [*]An option to hide your Gamertag has been added for the Sandbox mode.
    [*]Kill feed has been added for the Sandbox mode.
    [*]Level bounds now have a visual indicator for the Sandbox mode.
    [*]A City Center sign was added to Junkyard.
    [*]Delivery slot now spawns Rewards for every crate delivered during “Prime Deliverer”.
    [*]Sharks are now killable. Have fun.
    [*]Vehicle handling has been improved.
    [*]Sailboat in the Docks is now driveable.
    [*]More props were added throughout the Sandbox mode.
    [*]The electric Hammer now acts like Taser Glove (i.e. builds up a charge).
    [*]Caltrops have a greater slowdown effect.
    [*]Scorescreen automatically sorts by leader downward in PvP modes.
    [*]Limb loss has been tweaked so they don't fall off too easily. 
    [*]The host is now able to cancel votes started by clients.
[/list]

We hope you’ll all continue to enjoy Just Die Already! 

Thanks for the love and support.

notes.title: Just Die Already is out now, but there’s more!
notes.notes:
Just Die Already is out now, but there’s more!

Prime your walking sticks and get ready to unleash some geriatric mayhem, cause Just Die Already is finally out.

Having been kicked out of their retirement home, your (un)friendly boomers will have to risk their lives and limbs to qualify for the much-coveted free retirement care.

Team up with up to three other old folks in a fully cross-platform online multiplayer experience, and show those pesky millennials that age is just a number.

But we are sure you are dying to know what the future holds for Just Die Already: well, hang on to your dentures cause the first free post-launch update is going to be coming as early as this June and it will sport a brand-new Player vs Player mode that will see boomers fight for their lives across four never-before-seen arenas.

Want to be the first to know what else might be in store for the game? Then put on your reading glasses and follow [url=https://twitter.com/JustDieGame]@JustDieGame[/url] on Twitter or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@justdiealreadygame]@justdiealreadygame[/url] on TikTok to keep up with Frank’s rants and all the most recent news about Just Die Already!

[previewyoutube=QSutuueke4c;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/979070/Just_Die_Already/

notes.title: Just Die Already launches on Steam May 20th
notes.notes:
Having spent the last 12 months couped up in our houses, it’ll soon be time to collectively step out and breathe in the fresh air. Of course, that’s all before we strap two live fireworks to our tender bodies, propelling us up into the sky before we come crashing back down to the ground, landing in the open jaws of a handy shark who has taken refuge in a nearby river.

[h3]Oh wait. No. That’s Just Die Already - the old aged pensioner playground we're pleased to announce will launch on Steam [b]May 20th, 2021[/b]![/h3]

[previewyoutube=KDpSi56Tv5c;full][/previewyoutube]

Just Die Already might be a fictional tale of OAPs competing for spots in retirement homes, but given the folks in those homes have food & drink, company, and - most importantly - haircuts on tap, we're starting to think we should join then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37846010/ee6dca6eacbd98a85b62a33f1d8eec280a76f932.png[/img]

Don't forget to pre-order Just Die Already on Steam starting today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/979070/Just_Die_Already/

notes.title: Watch an old man beat YouTubers to death with sausages
notes.notes:
Soon, it will be time to head into the world of Just Die Already to take on the role of the world’s elderly - those greedy folks whose pension payments eat up all our taxes but could afford a decent home without a mortgage eating up their entire wage packet each month. Those damn old people. They don’t know they’re born, do they?!

Great, now I'm all worked up. Let's relax and watch some so-called influencers beat each other to death with sausages.

[previewyoutube=TKx7mpjWF18;full][/previewyoutube]
Ah, that's better.

And hey, while you wait for Just Die Already to arrive, why not stumble into the shoes of a man old enough not only to remember the day man first walked on the moon, but also the oft-forgotten day after, when Neil Armstrong was being hoisted on strings across a leftover set from Barbarella on a soundstage somewhere in Hollywood. Just Google it.

For more amazing insights into the world at large (wake up, sheeple!) follow Frank, our 90-year-old Community Manager, on his [b][url=https://twitter.com/justdiegame]awesome Twitter channel[/url][/b].

[url=https://twitter.com/justdiegame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37846010/7feb755aff78972705fc4967f49d57a0c439a84d.png[/img][/url]

We'll share more about Just Die Already’s launch date in the weeks ahead. Until then, why not give the game a cheeky Wishlist? Couldn't hurt.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/979070/Just_Die_Already/

notes.title: Just Die Already coming soon to Steam!
notes.notes:
Ever wanted to turn yourself into a human missile, launching yourself at your foe from a catapult? Probably.

Considered using your disembodied head as a weapon to take out your rival? Of course you have!

In Just Die Already, you take on the role of an Old Age Pensioner keen to secure a place at the World’s most luxurious retirement home. The only problem is, qualifying for that golden ticket means pushing your brittle old body to the limits, pulling off some extreme challenges like you've never seen before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37846010/64ef4b9232f689bfff1145b0399dbd314d54d934.gif[/img]


Just Die Already is filled to the brim with crazy tools and contraptions, allowing players – either solo or with up to three friends – to delight in the experimental, working out ever more incredible ways to secure the game’s fabled golden tickets.

But don't worry, you won't have to wait to visit the game’s crazy world yourself. [b]A demo version is available on Steam right now![/b] Hooray!

[previewyoutube=Om_lCU-JU-U;full][/previewyoutube]
